method: Reconstructed all generation, blind-review and baseline prompts with archived Step120 tokenizer on huawei-05; compared token count and SHA256.
limitations: Seven different rules, but three belong to rail infrastructure and vehicles. Single-run screening errors are not proof of stable inability. Two accepted items are direct recognition; one has duplicate false distractors and one is conditional on a stipulated Ro-Ro classification. All screening tasks excluded from training and evaluation partitions.
